tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Task rows, plant cards, bottom sheets, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Text-field fills, segmented-control tracks, photo placeholders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between list rows. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and outlined buttons. 3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, brand-soft and overdue-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: species names, due dates, captions. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the done check, the active tab, links. Text-safe on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button, FAB, done check).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chips, the completed-row flash, the all-done empty state. Ink on top.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Watering task icon and accent. Always paired with the droplet icon.

tokens.name: fertilize
tokens.usage: Fertilizing task icon and accent. Always paired with its icon.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Misting task icon and accent.

tokens.name: repot
tokens.usage: Repotting task icon and accent.

tokens.name: custom
tokens.usage: Custom and rotate task icons and accents.

tokens.name: overdue
tokens.usage: Overdue label text, icon and the overdue section header. Always with the word 'Overdue' or a day count and the clock icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: overdue-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the overdue chip. Ink or overdue text on top.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive actions (Delete). Always with an alert icon and words. Text-safe on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The date heading on Today. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the plant name on plant detail.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headers inside a screen (Overdue, Due today, Coming up).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Water when the top 3 cm of soil is dry.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Plant names in task rows and cards.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Due dates, intervals, species, timestamps. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase location labels and chip text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked text lines in a row; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Task row vertical padding; gap between cards in the plant grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on Today and plant detail.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding above a screen title; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, thumbnails in task rows, text fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Task rows, plant cards, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; the FAB uses radius-lg on a 56px square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The done check button and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Task rows and plant cards on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the FAB.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target for anything interactive.

tokens.name: thumb-row
tokens.usage: Plant thumbnail in a task row.

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, before the safe-area inset.
